Hey Hanavi, great mod and I really like the modification changes!

However I think there is a bug,

1. I turned off the AR changes in the config however my ADAR-15 is still automatic and so are the bot’s ADARs. I know turning off the config did something because the VPO209 is not automatic. It seems like the ADAR-15 will be full auto no matter what I do in the config.

2. As a suggestion, I would like to request to see if the changes can be made to be configured as single options rather than just groups alone if that is possible. I agree with some of the changes like the RPM changes on some of the AR’s but I don’t want a scav to pump Geksa into me at 450rpm so I keep the AR module false.

Appreciate it!
